dct_description_sm: This dataset was collected using Kinarm Robotic Assessment for the purpose of measuring cognitive function of people with epilepsy. This dataset includes participants with Temporal Lobe Epilepsy, and Genetic Generalized Epilepsy. Excluded groups include participants with bilateral temporal lobe epilepsy, juvenile absence epilepsy, childhood absence epilepsy, neurodegenerative disease comorbidity, (ex. dementia, stroke, etc...), significant intellectual disability, inability to speak and understand English, and/or brain surgery. Age range included is 18 to 65 years old. This study was supported by Queen’s University Faculty of Health Sciences and the PSI Foundation.
dct_title_s: Replication Data for: Preliminary identification of cognitive phenotypes in temporal lobe epilepsy and genetic generalized epilepsy using robotic assessment
